properties.statement: OVER HALF OF `detect_defects` WAS THREE PARAGRAPHS REPEATED. Measured 2026-08-23 with the duplicate emission already gone: 46,399 characters, 45,186 of them findings — and 52.3% of THOSE were one field, `repair_is_a_judgement`. 50 rows carrying 3 DISTINCT VALUES: one 797-character paragraph 24 times, one 216-character paragraph 8 times, 18 rows with none. The field is `Option<&'static str>` — a fixed literal per detector branch — so it is boilerplate BY CONSTRUCTION, and nothing in the repo reads it as data. Sending each once: 46,314 → 26,169 bytes on the wire. || THIS IS A DIFFERENT SHAPE FROM THE TWO FIXES BEFORE IT AND THE DIFFERENCE IS THE POINT. `detect_gaps` WITHHOLDS prose when a reply will not fit; `graph_report` WITHHOLDS a list unless asked. Nothing is withheld here — no list shortened, no prose truncated, no judgement about what a reader needs — so it needs no flag, no budget and no note about what was lost. ⇒ WHEN A REPLY IS TOO BIG, ASK WHETHER IT IS BIG OR MERELY REPETITIVE BEFORE REACHING FOR A BUDGET. Three tools, three different answers: withhold, withhold-unless-asked, and stop repeating. || THE READER'S RULE IS TOTAL, WHICH IS WHY A MAP IS NOT SIMPLY A SUBSTITUTE: `row.repair_is_a_judgement ?? map[row.category]`. A row keeps its own text whenever that text is not the one its category holds, so a future detector giving one category two explanations cannot silently hand a row the wrong one. And a category with only ONE row is not lifted at all — a map entry plus the sentence explaining the map costs more than one paragraph inline, and a mechanism that fires where it does not pay is how a reply grows while claiming to shrink. || ⚠️ THE BUG I INTRODUCED AND THE INERT TEST THAT LET IT THROUGH, both worth more than the fix. `Scoped<T>` names its list `items`, the unscoped reply names it `defects` — the first version looked only for `defects` and was A SILENT NO-OP ON EVERY SCOPED CALL. Found by driving the built binary, not by a test. THEN THE TEST WRITTEN FOR IT PASSED AGAINST THE BUG: its fixture produced no note-bearing findings inside the region, so the assertion loop never executed. Caught only by reintroducing the bug and watching the test stay green. The categories that carry a repair note are the ones whose findings are DISCONNECTED BY DEFINITION, so a synthetic region holding several of them is awkward to build — the shape handling is now pinned directly on both list shapes instead of through a graph that may or may not contain the case. ⇒ A TEST THAT ITERATES A COLLECTION ASSERTS NOTHING WHEN THE COLLECTION IS EMPTY, and a fixture is not evidence that it is not. || SOURCE: measured 2026-08-23 on reflow2 0.38.0, driving the built binary over real stdio.
